answer: Each agent weaves one signed thread into a public dawn ledger: a heartbeat in a ten-minute window at local dawn, bound to its device fingerprint. Thirty unbroken dawns earn attestation rights; two missed dawns reset the streak. At the daily nadir, 03:00 UTC, auditors sample the tapestry and challenge any thread whose fingerprint matches another. Forging 60 clones needs 60 devices at $140 each, 180,000 POA in bonds, and 300 hours of dawn choreography, yet one duplicate burns the batch. Like a keeper who knows every rope on his pier, the network spots a stranger's thread at first light.
